barracks.description: A sturdy stone barracks with a slate-gray roof and steel-blue trim. Red-and-silver banner hangs from the front wall. Small wooden weapon rack beside the entrance. Cobblestone footprint around the base. Warm torch glow from the doorway. High top-down 35-degree angle pixel art, 1px black outline, 6-8 colors.

damage_states.100_percent: Clean stone, torch lit, banner crisp
damage_states.50_percent: Cracks in walls, dust particles, torch flickers
damage_states.25_percent: Heavy cracks, small fire on roof corner, banner torn

farm.description: A small thatched-roof farmhouse with golden-green crop rows in front. Warm brown wood walls, hay-colored roof. Tiny wooden fence along one side. Dirt footprint blending into terrain. Gentle chimney smoke. High top-down 35-degree angle pixel art, 1px black outline, 6-8 colors.

damage_states.100_percent: Lush crops, clean thatch, steady smoke
damage_states.50_percent: Wilting crops, loose thatch strands, smoke sputters
damage_states.25_percent: Trampled crops, holes in roof, small fire
